title: Units
description: content/units.json: an array with every unit of the course in order. Each entry mirrors the Unit typedef in app/js/content/types.js; tools/lint-content.js checks this shape by hand.

level.description: The CEFR level the unit belongs to. Unit ids continue across levels.

lessonCount.description: How many lessons the unit has when complete: theme lessons, then one consolidation lesson last. A unit lists at most this many (lint rule lesson-count); one with fewer, but at least one, is a warning (lint rule unit-incomplete).

title_sl.description: Slovenian text: the 25 letters of the Slovenian alphabet, digits, spaces and the punctuation .,;:!?'"()- (lint rule alphabet).

motif.description: The hive motif drawn on the unit's panel.

lessons.description: Lesson ids in order. Each must exist as content/lessons/<id>.json and name this unit (lint rule reference), and its order is its position here (lint rule lesson-count).
